Premia is a decentralized options protocol. Premia operates on the Ethereum and Arbitrum blockchains. Premia uses liquidity pools to supply the counterparty for option trades. Premia is non-custodial, so users keep control of their assets through smart contracts.

Squeeth is a DeFi product from Opyn that gives exposure to squared ETH price movements. Squeeth is built on the Ethereum blockchain. Squeeth is issued as an ERC-20 token called oSQTH. Squeeth is implemented through smart contracts rather than through a centralized intermediary.

Ribbon is a DeFi options vault protocol that automates structured option strategies. Ribbon runs on the Ethereum blockchain. Ribbon pools user deposits into vaults that execute covered call and put-selling strategies. Ribbon is non-custodial, with vault logic enforced by smart contracts.

Loopring is a zero-knowledge rollup Layer 2 scaling protocol for Ethereum. Loopring processes transactions off the Ethereum mainnet and posts validity proofs to Ethereum. Loopring supports a decentralized exchange and payments on its Layer 2 network. Loopring uses zero-knowledge proofs to verify transaction validity.

Hyperliquid is a public Layer 1 blockchain with an on-chain perpetual futures exchange. Hyperliquid runs its own blockchain rather than building on Ethereum. Hyperliquid uses an on-chain central limit order book for trading. Hyperliquid executes trades through smart contract logic on its own chain without a centralized exchange operator.
